consulta: select p.user_id,p.full_name,p.is_admin,p.is_active,p.funcionario_alvo_codigo,p.alvo_usuario,exists(select 1 from hub_user_roles ur join hub_roles r on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=p.user_id and ur.revogado_em is null and r.codigo='lider_departamento') as papel_lider,public.user_has_permission(p.user_id,'compras.requisicoes.create') as pode_criar,public.user_has_permission(p.user_id,'compras.requisicoes.aprovar') as pode_aprovar,public.user_has_permission(p.user_id,'compras.requisicoes.reenviar_own') as pode_reenviar,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('cc',l.codigo_centro_ctrl,'nome',c.name,'ativo',c.is_active,'valid_from',c.valid_from,'valid_until',c.valid_until) order by l.codigo_centro_ctrl) from compras_lideres_cc l left join cost_centers c on c.erp_code=l.codigo_centro_ctrl where l.lider_user_id=p.user_id and l.ativo),'[]'::jsonb) as liderancas from profiles p where p.is_active and not p.is_admin and (exists(select 1 from compras_lideres_cc l where l.lider_user_id=p.user_id and l.ativo) or public.user_has_permission(p.user_id,'compras.requisicoes.create')) order by p.full_name
